title: Di sản các quốc đảo nhỏ: chiến lược UNESCO 2026–2034
subtitle: Small-island heritage and UNESCO’s 2026–2034 strategy

questions.en: UNESCO’s 2026 World Heritage update recorded 25 new inscriptions and announced a 2026–2034 strategy for small island developing states. small-island heritage faces linked pressures including coastal change, limited conservation capacity and unequal access to expertise.
